title: Align local Staging Governance privilege readiness with the canonical Staging grant overlay

phases.objective: Keep the Governance readiness evaluator exact while selecting the repository-owned local Staging Governance privilege matrix only for staging_local_windows_docker, so the three governed Activation Gateway planning tables are accepted in Staging without widening the Production/default contract.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Local Staging Governance readiness accepts the exact canonical 20-table/46-privilege Staging matrix while the default/Production path remains exact at 17 tables and 39 privileges.
steps: Use the existing Governance privilege matrix as the default expected matrix in the reusable readiness evaluator.
Resolve the local Staging expected matrix from STAGING_ROLE_GRANT_POLICIES.governance.required_operations_by_table only when DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT is staging_local_windows_docker.
Use the same environment-specific matrix for required schema-table census and exact privilege evaluation.
Reject missing Staging Gateway privileges and any privileges outside the selected matrix fail-closed.
assertions: The default Governance readiness contract remains 17 tables and 39 privileges.
Local Staging Governance readiness requires exactly 20 tables and 46 privileges.
The seven Staging-only privilege rows on the three Activation Gateway planning tables are accepted only in local Staging.
The default/Production evaluator continues to classify those seven rows as unexpected table scope.
Missing required Staging Gateway privileges remain blocking.
Privileges outside the selected environment matrix remain blocking.
No database, grant, provider, deployment, Cloudflare, Hostinger, or Production mutation is performed by this change.

phases.objective: Production behavior remains on the existing base Governance privilege matrix and this change authorizes no Production mutation or deployment.
blockers: Production remains outside this pull request and requires a separate governed promotion lifecycle.
No Production, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare, database, grant, or deployment mutation is authorized by this declaration.
